# 0. Prepare environment and Load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
```

# 1. Compare Results

## 1.1. SNP-GWAS
```{r}
# load data 
## SNPGWAS
SNPGWAS_RAxML <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_RAxML.txt")
SNPGWAS_FastTree <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.1.Fasttree/SNPGWAS_Fasttree.txt")
SNPGWAS_Mash     <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.2.Mash/SNPGWAS_mash.txt")
SNPGWAS_SC       <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.3.SC/SNPGWAS_SC.txt")

# Add significance column, with bonferonni correction for multiple testing
SNPGWAS_RAxML <- SNPGWAS_RAxML |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_RAxML), 1, 0))
SNPGWAS_FastTree <- SNPGWAS_FastTree |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_FastTree), 1, 0))
SNPGWAS_Mash <- SNPGWAS_Mash |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_Mash), 1, 0))
SNPGWAS_SC <- SNPGWAS_SC |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_SC), 1, 0))

# Compare tables
nrow(SNPGWAS_RAxML)
nrow(SNPGWAS_FastTree)
nrow(SNPGWAS_Mash)
nrow(SNPGWAS_SC)

# Compare variants
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant != SNPGWAS_FastTree$variant))
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant != SNPGWAS_Mash$variant))
length(which(! SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant))
length(which(! SNPGWAS_SC$variant %in% SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant))
# The SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with RAxML,FastTree and Mash have the same variants in the results table. 
# The SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with Poppunk SC has the same variants but 185 variants are not reported in the results table. 
# Why ? 
# At first, I thought it may be because Poppunk SC classification fails for some samples, such that they are not included in the GWAS. But that is not the case... 

# List of variants missing in SNPGWAS_SC
SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(! variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(variant)

# Compare unadjusted p-value for shared variants
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$filter.pvalue != SNPGWAS_FastTree$filter.pvalue))
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$filter.pvalue != SNPGWAS_Mash$filter.pvalue))
length(which((SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(filter.pvalue)) != SNPGWAS_SC$filter.pvalue))
# CCL: The SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with RAxML, FastTree and SC have the same lrt.pvalue for each variant they have in common.

# However, the lrt p-value are different for the SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with Mash. 


# Compare lrt.pvalue for shared variants
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$lrt.pvalue != SNPGWAS_FastTree$lrt.pvalue))
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$lrt.pvalue != SNPGWAS_Mash$lrt.pvalue))
length(which((SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(lrt.pvalue)) != SNPGWAS_SC$lrt.pvalue))
length(which((SNPGWAS_Mash |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(lrt.pvalue)) != SNPGWAS_SC$lrt.pvalue))
# CCL: The SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with RAxML, and FastTree have the same lrt.pvalue for each variant they have in common.
# However, the lrt.pvalues are different for the SNPGWAS with population structure controlled with Mash and SC.  

# Compare significance
table(SNPGWAS_RAxML$significance)
table(SNPGWAS_FastTree$significance)
table(SNPGWAS_Mash$significance)
table(SNPGWAS_SC$significance)
# Across all SNP-GWAS with different population structure control methods, there were no SNP variants significantly associated with the phenotype of interest (i.e. Disease onset age: EOD vs LOD)

# Compare beta (the effect size/slope of the variant)
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$beta != SNPGWAS_FastTree$beta))
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$beta != SNPGWAS_Mash$beta))
length(which((SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(beta)) != SNPGWAS_SC$beta))

# Compare variant_h2 (the variance in phenotype explained by the variant.)
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant_h2 != SNPGWAS_FastTree$variant_h2))
length(which(SNPGWAS_RAxML$variant_h2 != SNPGWAS_Mash$variant_h2))
length(which((SNPGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(variant_h2)) != SNPGWAS_SC$variant_h2))


# Plot
SNPGWAS_RAxML_V2 <- SNPGWAS_RAxML
colnames(SNPGWAS_RAxML_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("RAxML_", colnames(SNPGWAS_RAxML_V2)[-1]))
SNPGWAS_Mash_V2 <- SNPGWAS_Mash
colnames(SNPGWAS_Mash_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("Mash_", colnames(SNPGWAS_Mash_V2)[-1]))
SNPGWAS_SC_V2 <- SNPGWAS_SC
colnames(SNPGWAS_SC_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("SC_", colnames(SNPGWAS_SC_V2)[-1]))
SNPGWAS_ALL <- left_join(left_join(SNPGWAS_RAxML_V2, SNPGWAS_Mash_V2),SNPGWAS_SC_V2)

# # Compare p-value unadjusted for population structure
# SNPGWAS_ALL |>
#   ggplot()+
#   geom_point(aes(x=Mash_filter.pvalue, y= RAxML_filter.pvalue))+
#   geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
#   geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
#   geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
#   theme_classic()+
#   xlab("Mash distances")+
#   ylab("RAxML phylogeny")+
#   ggtitle("Unadjusted p-value")

# Compare p-value adjusted for population structure
SNPGWAS_ALL |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Mash_lrt.pvalue, y= RAxML_lrt.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Mash distances")+
  ylab("RAxML phylogeny")+
  ggtitle("LRT p-value")

# Compare p-value adjusted for population structure
SNPGWAS_ALL |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Mash_lrt.pvalue, y= SC_lrt.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("p-value adjusted for population structure with Mash distances")+
  ylab("p-value adjusted for population structure with SC phylogeny")



# # Heatmap
# rbind(SNPGWAS_RAxML |> select(variant, lrt.pvalue)|>  mutate(Pop_structure= "RAxML"),
#       SNPGWAS_Mash |> select(variant, lrt.pvalue)|>  mutate(Pop_structure= "Mash")) |>
#   ggplot(aes(variant, Pop_structure, fill = lrt.pvalue)) +
#   geom_tile() +
#   scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0.5) +
#   labs(x = "Column", y = "Row", fill = "Value") +
#   theme_minimal() +
#   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
#   ggtitle("Heatmap Example")
```


## 1.2. DB-GWAS
```{r}
# load data 
## DBGWAS
DBGWAS_RAxML <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_RAxML.txt")
DBGWAS_FastTree <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.1.Fasttree/DBGWAS_Fasttree.txt")
DBGWAS_Mash     <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.2.Mash/DBGWAS_mash.txt")
DBGWAS_SC       <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Preliminary Analysis/Lea Figures/Data/15.Pyseer/15.2.Subanalysis_1/16.2.3.SC/DBGWAS_SC.txt")

# Add significance column, with bonferonni correction for multiple testing
DBGWAS_RAxML <- DBGWAS_RAxML |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_RAxML), 1, 0))
DBGWAS_FastTree <- DBGWAS_FastTree |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree), 1, 0))
DBGWAS_Mash <- DBGWAS_Mash |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_Mash), 1, 0))
DBGWAS_SC <- DBGWAS_SC |> mutate(significance = ifelse(lrt.pvalue < 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_SC), 1, 0))

# Compare tables
nrow(DBGWAS_RAxML)
nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree)
nrow(DBGWAS_Mash)
nrow(DBGWAS_SC)

# Compare variants
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$variant != DBGWAS_FastTree$variant))
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$variant != DBGWAS_Mash$variant))
length(which(! DBGWAS_RAxML$variant %in% DBGWAS_SC$variant))
length(which(! DBGWAS_SC$variant %in% DBGWAS_RAxML$variant))
length(which((DBGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% DBGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(variant)) != DBGWAS_SC$variant))

# Compare unadjusted p-value for shared variants
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$filter.pvalue != DBGWAS_FastTree$filter.pvalue))
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$filter.pvalue != DBGWAS_Mash$filter.pvalue))
length(which((DBGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% DBGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(filter.pvalue)) != DBGWAS_SC$filter.pvalue))

# Compare lrt.pvalue for shared variants
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$lrt.pvalue != DBGWAS_FastTree$lrt.pvalue))
length(which(DBGWAS_RAxML$lrt.pvalue != DBGWAS_Mash$lrt.pvalue))
length(which((DBGWAS_RAxML |> 
  filter(variant %in% DBGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(lrt.pvalue)) != DBGWAS_SC$lrt.pvalue))
length(which((SNPGWAS_Mash |> 
  filter(variant %in% SNPGWAS_SC$variant)|> 
  pull(lrt.pvalue)) != SNPGWAS_SC$lrt.pvalue))

# Compare significance
table(DBGWAS_RAxML$significance)
table(DBGWAS_FastTree$significance)
table(DBGWAS_Mash$significance)
table(DBGWAS_SC$significance)

# Plot
DBGWAS_RAxML_V2 <- DBGWAS_RAxML
colnames(DBGWAS_RAxML_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("RAxML_", colnames(DBGWAS_RAxML_V2)[-1]))
DBGWAS_Mash_V2 <- DBGWAS_Mash
colnames(DBGWAS_Mash_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("Mash_", colnames(DBGWAS_Mash_V2)[-1]))
DBGWAS_SC_V2 <- DBGWAS_SC
colnames(DBGWAS_SC_V2) <- c("variant", paste0("SC_", colnames(DBGWAS_SC_V2)[-1]))
DBGWAS_ALL <- left_join(left_join(DBGWAS_RAxML_V2, DBGWAS_Mash_V2),DBGWAS_SC_V2)

# Compare p-value adjusted for population structure
DBGWAS_ALL |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Mash_lrt.pvalue, y= RAxML_lrt.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("p-value adjusted for population structure with Mash distances")+
  ylab("p-value adjusted for population structure with RAxML phylogeny")

# Compare p-value adjusted for population structure
DBGWAS_ALL |>
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=Mash_lrt.pvalue, y= SC_lrt.pvalue))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05/nrow(DBGWAS_ALL), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("p-value adjusted for population structure with Mash distances")+
  ylab("p-value adjusted for population structure with SC phylogeny")

```
